name: ledger-codex-gemini-usage-capture
title: Capture real codex and gemini token usage in the LLM usage ledger
description: The LLM usage ledger records real provider token usage only for the claude-code host. The codex and gemini real-subprocess dispatch paths (runCodexRealLeafDispatch / runGeminiRealLeafDispatch -> the shared runBoundedRealLeafDispatch in core/lattice-dispatch.ts) carry NO usage-ledger seam, and the bounded provider runners surface stdout as digest + byte-count only, so when LATTICE_USAGE_LEDGER is ON and a codex/gemini subprocess runs, no token usage is recorded. This story wires real usage capture for codex and gemini end to end: the bounded provider runners extract token-count-only usage (respecting the raw-output-never-surfaced security invariant), dispatch-usage.ts gains a canonical per-provider final-usage entry point, and runBoundedRealLeafDispatch records a preflight estimate plus a superseding final -- while keeping the claude path byte-identical and the ledger-OFF path byte-identical.
